The '''drifters' district''' was one of the districts of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Phemiss]]. It was separated from the rest of the city by the [[Pharine River]] and was primarily inhabited by [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurians]] who did not belong to a clan.<ref name="CatCW" />

The district was considered the liveliest part of the city, and was known for its juke joints and [[Restaurant/Legends|eateries]]. It also contained the [[Phemiss Low Port]], the largest [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] in the city. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] destroyed part of the district in order to build factories. They later added a number of avenues that cut up the district.<ref name="CatCW" />
